row.title: LEGACY-CLIENT-1: a Bluesky session is bound to its client metadata
row.body: Switching bluesky.json to private_key_jwt broke refresh of the live public-client session (HTTP 400 every tick from 2026-11-20 19:11). bluesky.json stays public; new sign-ins use bluesky-c.json. Never change a live atproto client's auth method; add a new client id.
